title: Geometry of the Minimal Level Set of the Effective Hamiltonian in Two Dimensions
summary: In this paper, we characterize the geometric structure of the boundary of the minimal level set $F_0$ of the effective Hamiltonian $\overline{H}$ associated with the mechanical Hamiltonian \[ H(p,x)=\frac12|p|^2+V(x) \] in dimension $n=2$, where $V$ on $\mathbb{T}^2=\mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2$ has a unique maximum and Hessian at this maximizer has two distinct negative eigenvalues.
